Excellent! I'm now in my declare attackers phase with 2hp vs their 2hp. I have Voice of Victory (1/3) and a new 1/1 Kithkin token, plus Floodpits Drowner (2/1). Attack with both Voice of Victory and the Drowner for exactly lethal (3 damage)!

I'm at 18 (took 2 damage somewhere — maybe from a land or High Noon trigger?). Opponent at 2. Let me check if they have any blockers:

annotations.description: With exactly 3 lands (Hallowed Fountain, Abandoned Air Temple, Floodfarm Verge) that can produce 1WW, casting Ajani, Outland Chaperone would be a stronger turn 3 play than Floodpits Drowner. Ajani is a planeswalker that generates incremental value through token creation and can threaten removal of tapped creatures. The Drowner's flash means it could be cast on the opponent's turn later, and its ETB tap ability is best used reactively. Playing Ajani first maximizes the value of having priority on turn 3 while the opponent has limited board presence (just a 1/2 Gene Pollinator and lands).
annotations.actionTaken: Chose to cast Floodpits Drowner (1U, 2/1 flash creature) during their own main phase.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Ajani, Outland Chaperone (1WW) to start generating Kithkin tokens and building planeswalker loyalty, then hold Floodpits Drowner for a future turn where its flash and tap ability would be more impactful.

annotations.description: The opponent has Badgermole Cub (2/2) and Keen-Eyed Curator (3/3) on the battlefield. Gene Pollinator and all lands are tapped, so there are no tapped creatures to target with the -2. However, looking more carefully at the board state, the opponent's Gene Pollinator IS tapped. Ajani's -2 deals 4 damage to target tapped creature - Gene Pollinator is tapped and could be killed. While Gene Pollinator is likely a smaller threat than the Keen-Eyed Curator or Badgermole Cub, killing it for free with Ajani's -2 removes a creature and is better than making a 1/1 token when facing down 3/3 and 2/2 creatures. The +1 creating a 1/1 chump blocker has some value, but removing an opponent's creature (even a small one) is generally more impactful, especially since Ajani is at 3 loyalty and going to 4 with +1 gives survivability. This is debatable - the +1 protects Ajani and builds board presence, but using -2 on Gene Pollinator removes a creature that generates value (pollinating/token making). Actually, Gene Pollinator is a 1/1 that likely has useful abilities. Killing it with a -2 (going to 1 loyalty) seems risky as Ajani becomes very vulnerable. The +1 to go to 4 loyalty while making a blocker is reasonable defensive play. On reflection, this is close to reasonable given Ajani's loyalty concerns.
annotations.actionTaken: Used Ajani's +1 to create a 1/1 Kithkin token, going to 4 loyalty.
annotations.betterLine: Could have used -2 to kill Gene Pollinator (a tapped creature), removing an opponent's value engine, though this would drop Ajani to 1 loyalty making it very vulnerable.

Furthermore, Voice of Victory (which prevents opponents from casting spells during your turn) could have been cast first, then Aven Interrupter could be saved for the opponent's turn to get value from its ETB exile ability.
